title: On the levels of rational regular orthogonal matrices for generalized cospectral graphs
summary: For an $n$-vertex graph $G$ with adjacency matrix $A$, the walk matrix $W(G)$ of $G$ is the matrix $[e,Ae,\ldots,A^{n-1}e]$, where $e$ is the all-ones vector. Suppose that $W(G)$ is nonsingular and $p$ is an odd prime such that $W(G)$ has rank $n-1$ over the finite field $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. Let $H$ be a graph that is generalized cospectral with $G$, and $Q$ be the corresponding rational regular orthogonal matrix satisfying $Q^\mathsf{T} A(G) Q=A(H)$.
